emhawkes

emhawkes specifies, simulates, and fits exponential Hawkes models, including marked, state-dependent, and multi-kernel models.

Installation

Install the CRAN release:

install.packages("emhawkes")

For the development version and the features described in the guides:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ksublee/emhawkes")

Source installation requires a C++ compiler and Rcpp; on Windows, install Rtools.

Quick start 

library(emhawkes)

h <- new("hspec", mu = 0.3, alpha = 1.2, beta = 1.5)
set.seed(1107)
path <- hsim(h, size = 1000)
fit <- hfit(h, inter_arrival = path$inter_arrival)
summary(fit)

hsim() returns an hreal path; hfit() returns a maxLik fit. The first path row is the initial state, so size includes that row.
